acceptance_criteria.criterion: All six node modules exist and follow the common Deep Agent pattern
Each node loads the correct persona prompt for its stage
Each node constructs a stage-appropriate user prompt with project path and WP ID
Each node creates a Deep Agent with LocalShellBackend and MCP tools
Error handling catches exceptions and returns stage_success: False without crashing
Node return values conform to the WorkflowState schema
PM node includes the plan document content in its prompt
Synthesis node does not require a current_wp_id

Implemented all 6 stage node modules: pm.py, developer.py, qa.py, reviewer.py, docs.py, synthesis.py — each with stage-specific prompt builder and make_<stage>_node() factory
PM node reads plan.md content and includes it verbatim in the agent prompt; synthesis node operates on full project without requiring current_wp_id
Implemented 64-test suite in test_nodes.py (structure, success path, error handling, persona loading, schema conformance, PM/synthesis-specific requirements) — 64/64 PASS in 0.91s
